instruction: Owner approves 1-2 overnight fine-tuning iterations of Gemma 3 270M; more examples via omp/DeepSeek: Owner 2026-09-30 evening, before leaving for the night: 1-2 training iterations of the small Gemma (Gemma 3 270M) are approved. No move to a larger model unless there is clear evidence that 270M cannot learn more. If it can still learn, generate more examples with omp + DeepSeek flash. Scope: the proofing LLMs (LanguageProofingLLM on bad_english first, then SymbolicProofingLLM on neuro_english if its targets are ready), with the usual gates: preregistration, dry run, staged early stopping, evaluation on the sealed tests and the composed per-sentence suites.
